title: Dead deal resurrector: Kesko / Heikki Nurmilaakso

blocks.label: Reconnect strength
blocks.why: The deal stalled at procurement's group-level vendor assessment, which was the unresolved objection on 2026-02-03. Kesko's public news since then changes the context: a large Nordic acquisition is moving toward close and the company is investing in warehouse automation. Heikki's own contact is a customer service development role, so a link to the acquisition is plausible but not confirmed. The score is lower than it could be because we have no evidence that the K-Rauta customer service project itself is back on the agenda.

items.text: Kesko agreed to acquire Dahl's technical trade operations in Sweden, Norway and Denmark from Saint-Gobain, debt-free price €1.2bn, completion targeted by end-2026.
Kesko plans a €500-700m rights issue to refinance part of the bridge financing for the Dahl acquisition; EGM on 2026-10-30 to authorise it. Terms not yet set.
European Commission unconditionally approved the Dahl acquisition; completion still depends on other conditions.
Manhattan Associates announced Kesko selected its ActiveWarehouse cloud warehouse solution, with an initial rollout across five distribution centres.
Q2 2026 comparable operating profit rose to €194m; full-year 2026 guidance narrowed to €670-730m.

blocks.text: The reason to reconnect is the procurement objection itself. When Heikki said group procurement had to assess new vendors first, the blocker was the timeline. Kesko is now in a period where a large integration and a capital raise are competing for management attention, and the Dahl deal is expected to close around the same time the vendor assessments would normally run. That makes it a plausible moment for procurement to revisit its queue, or for Heikki to know whether the assessment can be started early. The warehouse news shows Kesko is buying automation through formal vendor routes, which is useful to know. We don't know whether the K-Rauta email project has moved, and the message should ask rather than assume.

blocks.label: Reconnect message to Heikki Nurmilaakso
blocks.text:
Hi Heikki,

We last spoke in February, when procurement needed to assess the email triage assistant at group level before a slot could be set. I've been following Kesko's news since then, including the Dahl acquisition moving toward close.

I'm not sure whether the K-Rauta customer service work is still on your list. If it is, the security and GDPR materials could be ready for procurement's assessment whenever it fits their queue. If priorities have shifted, I'd still value your view on where customer service development is heading.

Would a short call make sense?

Best,
[Name]
